_noteP: P (Heat Management, Overheat bonus) previously curated 'TotalBaseDamage' (ByCharLevelInterpolation 5->40 + 0.25xAP) matches wiki's Overheat bonus-damage base+AP terms, kept unchanged. Re-checking the full wiki line ('5 - 44.12 (based on level) (+ 25% AP) (+ 4% of the target's maximum health) bonus magic damage on-hit') found a previously OMITTED third term: RumbleHeatSystem.DataValues 'OverheatPercBonusDamage' = flat 0.04 (4%, rank-invariant) -- a standalone %maxHP DataValue with no accompanying GameCalculation (native-code-applied, same shape as Vayne W). _noteQ: Q (Flamespitter) was previously curated as a single 'FlatDamage' hit (count=1), undercounting the channeled cone's real total by omitting its %maxHP component entirely. RumbleQ.mSpellCalculations 'FlatDamage' = BaseDamage DataValue + 1x APRatio(1.05, i.e. 105% AP) -- shape-matches wiki's 'Maximum Magic Damage' full-channel-total line (currently 62.5-187.5 + 131.25% AP; BIN's cached 50-150 base + 105% AP is a uniform 1.25x patch-drift factor below wiki's live numbers, confirmed by an EXACT 1.25x ratio holding across every one of the 5 ranks -- shape/mechanic match, only the live patch has since buffed it, values still resolve live from the BIN at runtime per the dynamic-lookup Hard Rule). The missing %HP term: RumbleQ.DataValues 'HealthDamage' = [0.06,0.065,0.07,0.075,0.08] per rank, independently confirmed by the SAME 1.25x ratio against wiki's Maximum-line %HP term (7.5/8.75/10% etc). Added as a second hpPercentDataValue hit. Both hits together represent Flamespitter's FULL 3-second channel total if it lands the whole time (matches the project's established 'use the already-a-total calc, don't re-multiply by tick count' convention from MonkeyKing R) -- count stays 1 for each (not per-tick).
_noteR: R (The Equalizer) was previously curated as 'DamagePerSecond' (count=1), drastically undercounting a persistent multi-second zone by using only a 1-second-rate number as if it were the whole hit. RumbleR.mSpellCalculations has a second, distinct 'TotalDamage' (GameCalculationModified, tooltipOnly=true) = DamagePerSecond x TrailDuration(4.5s DataValue) -- Riot's own precomputed full-field-lifetime total, matching the shape of wiki's 'Maximum Magic Damage' line (600-1400 + 175% AP is the theoretical max over the full ~5s max-burning-stack window; the BIN's TrailDuration-based total uses the field's 4.5s lifetime instead, a close, honest, BIN-native approximation, not the padded 5s stacking-refresh edge case). Switched the curated calc from 'DamagePerSecond' to this 'TotalDamage'. This assumes a target stands in the field for its full lifetime, which is optimistic for an escapable ground zone (per this project's Malzahar-style honesty convention) -- documented via the Zone tag rather than a silent full-duration assumption. Tagged BurstCeiling: The Equalizer is by a wide margin Rumble's largest single-ability damage contribution and signature duel-winning tool.
